title: Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture
chunks: The Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture is a Golden Globe Award that was first awarded by the Hollywood Foreign Press Association in 1944 for a performance in a motion picture released in the previous year. The formal title has varied since its inception; since 2005, the award has officially been called "Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture". Six actors have won the award twice: Richard Attenborough, Edmund Gwenn, Martin Landau, Edmond O'Brien, Brad Pitt, and Christoph Waltz. == Winners and nominees == === 1940s === === 1950s === === 1960s === === 1970s === === 1980s === === 1990s === === 2000s === === 2010s === === 2020s === == Multiple nominations == == Multiple wins == 2 wins Richard Attenborough (consecutive) Edmund Gwenn Martin Landau Edmond O'Brien Brad Pitt Christoph Waltz == See also == Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor BAFTA Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role Independent Spirit Award for Best Supporting Male Critics' Choice Movie Award for Best Supporting Actor Screen Actors Guild Award for Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Supporting Role == References == == External links ==
